title: (Junior) Data Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Stellendetails

Für unsere Standorte Mainz oder Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Voll- oder Teilzeit und zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre eine*n (Junior) Data Analyst (m/w/d).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Aufbereitung, Analyse und Visualisierung von Daten im Zusammenhang mit medienwissenschaftlichen Fragestellungen
  • Du erstellst Datenanalysen, vor allem aus den Bereichen Social Media und Videoforschung
  • Du baust interaktive Dashboards, um komplexe Ergebnisse verständlich darzustellen
  • Du arbeitest an spannenden Data-Science-Projekten mit - von der Entwurfsphase (inkl. Prototyping) über die Entwicklung bis hin zu einer produktiven Nutzung
  • Du wirkst bei der Konzeptionierung und Analyse des Trackings unserer digitalen Produkte (Web und App) mit
  • Du berätst unsere Data Engineers, Data Scientists und Kund*innen zu den Themen Daten, Visualisierung, Methoden und Tools
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Medienwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du zeichnest dich durch dein ausgeprägtes Wissen und deine Affinität zu Daten und Begriffen wie z. B. Metrik, KPI oder Interaktionen aus
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in den Bereichen statistische Verfahren, datengetriebene analytische Methoden und Techniken der Datenvisualisierung sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in deren praktischer Anwendung
  • Du kannst komplexe Problemstellungen aufnehmen und zusammen mit einem Team an datenbasierten Lösungen arbeiten
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit Tools zur Daten-Visualisierung (z. B. Google Cloud Data Studio, Power BI, Tableau) und mit SQL-Abfragen
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über erste Erfahrungen mit Programmiersprachen wie z. B. Python
  • Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzustellen
  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich und kannst dich sehr gut selbst strukturieren
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Unser Angebot an dich

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum für eigenverantwortliches Handeln. In unserem motivierten und sympathischen Team herrscht eine entspannte, aber professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre. Dich erwartet nicht nur ein attraktiver, moderner und ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz, sondern darüber hinaus viele spannende Themen. Wir sind immer offen für innovative Ideen und freuen uns auf deinen Input. Damit du Arbeits- und Privatleben bestmöglich kombinieren kannst, sind nach Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mobilen Anteilen sowie eine flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung möglich. Neben netten Kolleg*innen erwarten dich hier außerdem regelmäßige Firmenevents, eine tolle Verkehrsanbindung, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unfallversicherung, und vieles mehr. Zur Unterstützung deiner Work-Life-Balance kannst du dich außerdem auf 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub sowie zwei weitere freie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12. freuen.


Kontakt

Da sich unser Content an eine vielseitige Gesellschaft richtet, möchten wir auch in unseren Teams die gesellschaftliche Vielfalt repräsentieren. Auch, wenn du unserem Anforderungsprofil nicht zu 100% entsprichst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich durch deinen Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Arbeitsproben und ein Motivationsschreiben kennenzulernen. Wir freuen uns außerdem, wenn du uns neben deiner Gehaltsvorstellung auch dein frühestmögliches Eintrittsdatum verrätst.
 
 Deine Ansprechpersonen:
 Jana, Yvonne & Marius (Fachabteilung)
 Nina (Recruiting)
 
  Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role 

As Data Analyst in Operations at FINN, you will be at the heart of driving our business operations through data-driven insights. By leveraging advanced analytics tools and techniques, you will uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and provide actionable recommendations that validate the impact of strategic decisions. This role is perfect for a proactive problem solver who thrives in a data-rich environment. We’ve fully embraced AI-assisted development to amplify our impact, and we’re looking for a teammate who is excited to build and innovate using modern, AI-driven workflows too.


Your Responsibilities
  • Be a Domain Expert: As a domain expert, lead in-depth and advanced analysis of Operations data to uncover actionable insights that elevate performance and drive strategic decisions in areas like logistics, customer service, damage management, and risk assessment.
  • Own the semantics of Operations data: As the authority on Operations metrics, you ensure a unified data language across the domain. By standardizing key terminology, you enable deeper insights and faster decision-making for accelerated growth and improved operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Craft Compelling Narratives: Transform complex data into visually stunning dashboards, reports and appealing data stories that tell a clear status and allow actionable insights.
  • Be a Data Evangelist: Partner with cross-functional business, tech teams and data teams to continuously enhance data processes and tools, ensuring every move is backed by cutting-edge analytics.

    • Your Profile
  • Graduated with a Master’s degree in a quantitative field of study.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data analytics with a focus on Operations Domain at a scaleup.
  • Advanced SQL modeling with dbt (Data Build Tool).
  • Proficiency in data visualization with Looker (or similar BI tool).
  • Proficiency in applying statistical analysis.
  • Python skills with strong willingness to learn more.
  • Proven experience integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) into your daily analytics workflow to write code, explore data, and ship work.
  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

    • Why FINN?
  • Remote Work: You have the flexibility to work either in our Munich office or remotely in Germany.

  • Shared Success (VSOP Equity Program): We win together. Through our Virtual Stock Option Program, you benefit directly from the long-term growth and success of FINN.

  • Fuel your Growth (3.000€ Development Budget): Standing still is not an option. With your annual development budget for further training and seminars, you decide how you want to grow personally and professionally.

  • Family First (Childcare Subsidy & Flexibility): We support you and your family. Benefit from a monthly childcare subsidy, exclusive access to daycare spots in Munich, and maximum flexibility to balance work and family life stress-free.

  • Company Pension Scheme (bAV): We think about your future. FINN subsidizes your company pension plan with a strong employer contribution of 66%.

  • Experience our Product (25% Car Subscription Discount): Become a FINN driver yourself! You will receive a generous employee discount or can alternatively take advantage of our attractive bike leasing scheme.

  • Health & Mindset (Sports & Wellbeing): Your energy is our drive. Benefit from a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership for fitness and sports, as well as professional mental health support.

  • Munich Office Life: Barista-style coffee, matcha, and a luscious fruit basket await you at our modern headquarters in Munich. On top of that, there is a daily lunch subsidy for those in the office.

  • Team Spirit & Corporate Events: We are more than just colleagues. Whether it's summer events by the lake or simply a relaxed after-work drink, we celebrate our milestones together at regular team events.

    • About Us

    FINN is Germany’s leading car subscription platform and one of the country's few unicorns in the mobility sector. With over 400 colleagues from more than 40 nations, we are building the future of mobility and making access to your own car more seamless than ever before. What truly makes us proud, however, isn’t just the numbers, but what lies behind them: our strong team drive, the will to challenge the status quo, and the ambition to make a real difference. With us, you have the opportunity to take on direct responsibility in one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in Germany and actively shape our success story. We´re just getting started!

    More information: www.finn.com

     

    Equal Opportunities for Everyone

    FINN is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

     

    Ready for the future of mobility? Apply now!

    Come on board and become part of our Hyper-Growth Story! Your first point of contact is Anna - we keep things moving fast and guide you every step of the way. Everything you need to know about our hiring process and company culture is in our Recruiting Booklet.

title: BI Data Analyst
description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a BI Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You will take ownership of analytical projects end-to-end — from scoping business problems through to insight delivery — working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Product, Commercial and Operations. You will build and maintain critical dashboards and reporting, surface trends and anomalies in business performance, and use data storytelling to drive measurable business outcomes. You will be expected to leverage AI tools strategically throughout your workflow — from LLM-assisted query generation and analysis summarisation to code review — accelerating delivery while maintaining rigorous standards. You will also provide critical support as the human-in-the-loop to ensure accuracy and repeatability of data analysis in other functions, empowering all our teams to make full use of AI-driven data self-serve

What will you do

  • Take business problems and independently structure them into well-defined analytical tasks

  • Own KPI monitoring and reporting for embedded stakeholder teams, ensuring data accuracy to build quality and confidence in your outputs

  • Root cause and explain in detail data discrepancies, finding solutions to stakeholder problems

  • Build Looker dashboards and Hex notebooks to support deep-dive analysis and stakeholder self-serve

  • Write production-quality SQL and Python, following team coding standards and passing peer review. Additionally assist others to review AI generated outputs.

  • Communicate insights and recommendations clearly — constructing narratives that drive action

  • Use AI tools to improve workflow (e.g. query generation, analysis drafts, documentation) while maintaining quality and accuracy

  • Work with Analytics Engineers to ingest new data sources into the stack as needed

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

Applications close Monday 24th August.

title: Sales Data Analyst
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Sales Analyst, Intelligent Commerce will support Zilch’s Intelligent Commerce sales team with the reporting, insights, and campaign analysis needed to win, grow, and retain merchant partners.

Working closely with Sales, Commercial, Product, and Product Analytics, you’ll help size audiences, support campaign setup, monitor performance, and produce clear reporting that demonstrates value to brands.

You’ll use customer, transaction, merchant, and campaign data to understand what is working, where performance can improve, and which opportunities are most commercially valuable.

This is more than a reporting role. You’ll turn analysis into practical recommendations that help improve campaigns, strengthen merchant relationships, and support Zilch’s growth towards a payments media network.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Build and maintain dashboards for campaign, merchant, revenue, and margin performance.

  • Support Sales with audience sizing, customer insights, category analysis, and pitch materials.

  • Help define campaign KPIs, reporting requirements, and measurement approaches.

  • Monitor live campaign performance and highlight risks or optimisation opportunities.

  • Produce clear post-campaign reporting and recommendations for merchants.

  • Analyse performance across merchants, audiences, placements, and campaign types.

  • Track repeat bookings, merchant retention, revenue, and portfolio trends.

  • Partner with Product Analytics to connect campaign results with customer behaviour and transactions.

  • Improve reporting processes, data quality, and commercial metric definitions.

What we're looking for.

  • Around 1–2 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and confidence working with data independently.

  • Experience building dashboards or recurring reports in a BI tool.

  • Good commercial judgement and an understanding of metrics such as revenue, margin, conversion, ROAS, and retention.

  • Able to explain what happened, why it happened, and what should happen next.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly for merchant-facing analysis.

  • Clear communication skills and confidence working with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable working across multiple priorities.

Bonus skills.

  • Sales Analytics

  • Revenue Analytics

  • Marketing Analytics

  • Ecommerce

  • Payments

  • Advertising

title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
description:
Baue mit LiveEO den Marktführer in der Satellitenanalyse auf

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
  • Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
  • Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
  • Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
  • Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
  • Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
  • Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Dein Profil

  • A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
  • Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
  • A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
  • Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python and SQL
  • Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
  • Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
  • AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
  • Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
  • Software engineering experience
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Unsere Benefits

  • The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.
